summary: The school principal emphasizes the importance of E-Rate for maintaining essential infrastructure and budget stability, urging the FCC to preserve and strengthen the program rather than eliminate it.

claims.argument: Reducing or eliminating E-Rate would drastically impact school budgets
claims.evidence_quote: St Anthony Catholic School has received $26,406 in committed federal E-Rate support over funding years 2021–2025 — an average of roughly $5,281 a year toward the connections our students depend on. That support does not represent a one-time build; it is the recurring cost of keeping a modern network running.
